scope: Real macOS window controls, pointer, keyboard, screenshots; product mutations use token-free in-memory DEV fixtures

checks.name: Actual native zoom changes the window from 720×528 to 1512×917 and back
Account action remains inside both native viewports
Native auth accepts dummy input, masks password and focuses Email on invalid-email submission
Tab reaches confirmation input after a mouse-opened Delete Work dialog
Escape dismisses Delete Work, restores Delete Work focus and retains the fixture profile
At 720px, mouse-opened New profile dismisses with Escape and restores New profile focus
Native appearance switches to Dark and Light
Pending cloud is blue and matches expanded Settings diagnostics
Partial cloud is amber and matches Settings auth200/database503/storage200 fixture diagnostics

limitations: Production-bundle boot used a temporary copy with a distinct macOS bundle identifier and isolated native data.
Empty SUPABASE environment intentionally disables native login; configuration gating is expected in its screenshot.
No personal browser data, live account, real cloud mutations, native browser writes or cross-Mac convergence were tested.
The production bundle is a local debug package, unsigned and not notarized.
